messages.error.csrf_invalid: Page verification expired. Refresh the page and try again.
messages.error.body_too_large: The request exceeds the local size limit.
messages.error.invalid_json: Use a valid JSON object without duplicate fields or excessive nesting.
messages.error.unsupported_content_type: Use the media type required by this endpoint.
messages.error.internal_error: The local service could not complete the operation. Check the test state.
messages.error.not_found: The requested resource was not found.
messages.error.invalid_request: The request does not match the interface contract.
messages.error.export_not_terminal: Wait for the test to finish before exporting.
messages.error.export_not_found: The published export was not found. Generate it again.
messages.error.export_integrity: The export changed or could not be verified. Generate it again; source records are retained.
messages.error.export_source_invalid: The source could not be bound to this test.
messages.error.export_evidence_invalid: Evidence is missing or damaged. You can export without evidence, retaining that limitation.
messages.error.export_format_unavailable: This export did not include that format.
messages.error.export_size_limit: The export exceeds the local 256 MiB limit.
messages.error.archive_upload_limit: The ZIP upload exceeds the local size limit.
messages.error.archive_timeout: The ZIP upload or processing timed out. Try again.
messages.error.archive_integrity: The ZIP is damaged or its integrity checks do not match.
messages.error.archive_unsupported: This ZIP format is unsupported. Use a classic ZIP file.

messages.error.archive_member_type: The ZIP must contain regular files only.

messages.error.archive_member_limit: A ZIP member exceeds the file size limit.
messages.error.archive_json_limit: A JSON member exceeds the document size limit.
messages.error.archive_member_count_limit: The ZIP contains too many files.
messages.error.archive_directory_limit: ZIP directory metadata exceeds the size limit.
messages.error.archive_inventory_mismatch: The ZIP inventory does not match its contents.

messages.error.diagnostic_preview_owner: This import preview belongs to another browser session.
messages.error.diagnostic_preview_expired: The import preview expired. Upload it again.
messages.error.diagnostic_preview_not_found: The import preview was not found. Upload it again.
messages.error.diagnostic_preview_not_ready: The import preview is not ready.
messages.error.diagnostic_preview_integrity: The import preview changed. Upload it again.
messages.error.diagnostic_baseline_not_found: The imported baseline was not found.
messages.error.diagnostic_baseline_integrity: Baseline files changed or could not be verified.
messages.error.diagnostic_context_mismatch: Diagnostic context does not match its source run.
messages.error.diagnostic_source_mismatch: The diagnostic package does not match its source records.
messages.error.diagnostic_retest_unavailable: This baseline cannot establish a controlled retest. Configure a separate current test.
messages.shell.note: Model requests begin only after explicit start
messages.run.unavailable: No verified case records are available. Execution state does not establish compatibility.
messages.run.no_issues_final: No issues in this sample’s assessed checks
messages.run.no_issues_active: No recorded issues yet; the test is still running
messages.run.dimension_summary: Behavior passed {behavior}; protocol / identity checks failed {protocol}
messages.activity.separate: Local connectivity, worker observation and upstream activity are separate observations.
messages.activity.note: Times are recorded observations. Waiting for headers does not prove TCP connection; receive activity does not identify the first token.
messages.matrix.label: Passing / assessed
messages.matrix.note: Each cell retains all case states. Unassessed, waiting and skipped items are not passes.
messages.filter.label: Filter
messages.case.no_attempt: No verified attempt records are available.
messages.issue.title: Issue diagnosis
messages.issue.overlap: Issue families may overlap; their case counts must not be added.
messages.issue.stop_fields.title: Incomplete stop fields
messages.issue.stop_fields.impact: A tested response lacks stop fields required by the selected contract. An absent field differs from explicit null.
messages.issue.stop_fields.action: Check field preservation and translation for the linked request, then retest the entire original scope.
messages.issue.model_identity.title: Response model differs from configured identity
messages.issue.model_identity.impact: The observed model does not satisfy the configured request-name or alias policy. This alone does not prove misrouting.
messages.issue.model_identity.action: Check the model and declared aliases. Only explicit mappings can establish an accepted identity.
messages.issue.stream.title: Stream order or termination differs from the contract
messages.issue.stream.impact: Linked events triggered a deterministic stream assertion. Task completion and protocol results remain separate.
messages.issue.stream.action: Inspect the linked events and read boundaries; retain the evidence and retest.
messages.issue.response.title: Response structure differs from the selected contract
messages.issue.response.impact: This describes an observed field or stop-semantics difference and does not locate an internal cause.
messages.issue.response.action: Check expected and observed records, and share the linked evidence with the service maintainer.
messages.issue.environment.title: Execution or evidence conditions are insufficient
messages.issue.environment.impact: The current record cannot fully verify this check and cannot count as a pass.
messages.issue.environment.action: Check request and capture limits, retain the failed attempt, and retest.
messages.issue.behavior.title: Task behavior did not meet the case requirement
messages.issue.behavior.impact: The original behavior verdict is retained. Valid structure does not establish task completion.
messages.issue.behavior.action: Inspect the input, task condition and observed response, then retest the original scope.
messages.compare.none: Choose a local test or imported diagnostic bundle to inspect paired changes.
messages.compare.comparable: Judgment conditions match; changes describe these samples only
messages.compare.incomparable: Conditions or evidence do not establish a controlled repair
messages.compare.clean: All previously failing checks passed this sample
messages.compare.limits: One original sample and one retest do not establish cause, stability or complete client compatibility.
messages.form.title: New test
messages.form.intro: Enter an endpoint and model, review the address, fixed rules and cases, then start. Configuration and preview do not contact the model.
messages.form.name: Display name
messages.form.model_hint: Exact model identifier accepted by the endpoint
messages.form.container_hint: 127.0.0.1 inside a container refers to that container. For the host, Docker Desktop can use host.docker.internal; Linux needs host-gateway configuration. Addresses are never changed automatically.
messages.form.identity_match: Response matches the requested model or declared aliases
messages.form.identity_structure: Structure only; do not judge model identity
messages.form.credential_note: Kept only in this page and job memory, never in presets, reports or browser storage.
messages.form.scope_note: Forced tool choice is not a complete tool loop. Client and SDK/CLI workflows are outside these four cases.
messages.form.exclusion_note: Declaring no support does not remove required cases. Skipped items cannot establish a complete pass.
messages.form.no_retry: Fixed requests, no retries; each case also bounds max_tokens.
messages.form.preview_note: Preview shows the effective address, exact cases, fixed versions and required scope.
messages.form.consent: Start explicitly executes the reviewed endpoint plan. Configuration changes require another preview.
messages.form.copied: Local configuration copied without credentials. Preview again and explicitly start.
messages.form.baseline: The original record is reference data. Enter a local endpoint and review conditions; the complete original scope is retained.
messages.form.no_js: Configuration and start require JavaScript; saved records remain readable.
messages.form.local_endpoint_blank: Local endpoint and credentials are never adopted automatically from an import.
messages.history.title: Tests
messages.history.intro: Completion means execution ended. Open a test to inspect scope, compatibility results and evidence limits.
messages.import.title: Import diagnostic bundle
messages.import.intro: Import for reading and retest preparation. Endpoints and contents in the bundle are never executed.
messages.import.note: Limit 256 MiB; classic ZIP only. Original bytes are retained; review business data and endpoint context before sharing.
messages.baseline.limited: This record has limited conditions or evidence. It remains readable but cannot establish a controlled repair.
messages.export.title: Export and share
messages.export.note: Export sends no model requests. Diagnostic ZIPs retain source endpoint context and are not anonymized.
messages.export.wait: Freeze an export after execution ends; original failed attempts are retained.
messages.compare.wait: Paired comparison is available after execution ends.
messages.issue.policy_reference: Configured identity policy, not request-body fields
messages.evidence.truncated: Display limited to 256 KiB. Download the original evidence for the full content.
messages.import.too_large: Choose a ZIP file no larger than 256 MiB.
messages.import.ready: Original scope is available for controlled retest.
messages.import.readonly: Saved for reading; controlled retest is unavailable.
messages.preview.single_attempt: One attempt per case; no retries
messages.preview.changed: Configuration changed during preview. Preview again.
messages.form.positive_limits: Limits must be finite positive numbers; request, event and byte limits must be integers.
messages.form.need_credential: Enter this run’s credential or select an allowed server variable before starting.
messages.form.preset_saved: Preset saved without credentials. Existing tests are unchanged.
messages.export.choose_format: Select at least one export format.
messages.export.partial: Partial execution; no final result.json is included.
messages.export.freeze: Freeze this result and the selected report formats.
messages.export.with_evidence: The ZIP includes the listed evidence; standalone HTML has no captures. Review business data before sharing.
messages.export.without_evidence: Evidence files omitted; recipients cannot independently verify the source.
messages.export.created: Export generated. Previous exports remain available for repeated download.
messages.error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP address without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
messages.error.ambiguous_url: Base URL must be an origin or /v1. Use a complete Messages URL for other paths.
messages.error.invalid_document: Invalid local response. Refresh to inspect existing records.
messages.error.session: Unable to restore the local session. Refresh; existing tests are retained.
messages.error.session_failed: Session recovery failed. Check local cookies; existing tests are retained.
messages.error.session_restored: Session restored. The operation was not resent. Inspect existing tests before explicitly previewing or retrying.
messages.case.last_progress: Last progress record: {state}; retained checks are available in details.
messages.compare.group_note: Grouped by observation type; affected cases may overlap.
